existing Rust crate `deeptools`. The C++ is ONE translation unit, crustify-bridge3/cpp/bridge3.cpp,
and NOTHING BUILDS IT — it does heavy member access on opaque MLIR/LLVM/dcc reference types that
cpp/prelude.inc deliberately only CATALOGUES by name. The load-bearing property is that the bodies
are verbatim and verified untruncated (130/130), not that the extract compiles.
⛔ SO: no C configure, no C build, no sanitizer baseline, no reusable pre-build to look for, no
io_equiv harness, no -sys crate, no bindgen. There is no C to call.
⛔ YOUR ONLY GATES ARE `cargo check -p deeptools` AND `cargo test -p deeptools`, run ONCE at the
end of the batch. Do NOT run the workspace build or the acceptance build
